title: VisaLane Classifier Output (visa extension)
description: Extends the existing job_radar combined classifier output with VisaLane visa-sponsorship fields. Emitted by Python batch classification (src/job_radar/classifiers/relevance.py) and mirrored by any TS-side classifier. Cached results missing the new fields MUST be backfilled from the deterministic visa evaluator (visa/evaluator.py score_job_visa).

visa_sponsorship_confidence.description: 0-100 confidence that the employer sponsors work visas for this role.

visa_sponsorship_verified.description: true ONLY when the JD explicitly offers sponsorship/relocation, or the company is on the known-sponsors allowlist. LLM guesses alone never set this true.

visa_types.description: Named programs when stated, e.g. ['H-1B','TN'], ['Skilled Worker Visa']. Empty when unspecified.
